answers: Review round 1 of pull request #2511: all five findings, and nothing else.

proof.criterion: Finding 1 — the related-item check's three forms are judged in one place, and the CLI's printed lines do not move by one byte.
proof.surface: the CLI's own byte-for-byte guard on its printed advice, packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/dispatch-advice.test.ts, run unmodified
proof.command: cd /legion/workspaces/sjawhar/legion/infra-570 && bun test packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/dispatch-advice.test.ts && bun test packages/contracts packages/envoy-client
proof.observed: 57 pass / 0 fail across that one file, and 1410 tests across 58 files with 0 fail for the two packages. `relatedCheckFormOf`, `relatedCheckModeWords` and `relatedCheckSearchWords` now live in packages/contracts/src/related-forms.ts; packages/envoy-client/src/related-check.ts and packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/RelatedItems.tsx both read that union and only word it, and the `?? []` the reviewer named is gone (the server always sends `related`: suggestions.go:177,376). The branch order is the contract's, documented as such.
proof.negativeControl: The guard is the control: `jj diff -r cd5fae7d2fdd..@ packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/ packages/contracts/src/dispatch-api.ts` is empty, so neither the test file nor the contract types were touched — the move is proven against the assertions as they already stood, and any drift in a sentence would have failed them.

proof.criterion: Finding 2 — a related answer is never served from a cache older than the check it stands for.
proof.surface: Dispatch dashboard new-issue dialog in Chromium, real Go Dispatch server, production SPA bundle, Postgres 18.6 with pgvector; new row 'a title checked before an issue was filed is checked again, not answered from before'
proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun run build:web && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=2 e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts
proof.observed: 10 passed (35.0s). The row types a title, sees 'Related-item check searched (keywords only: …) and found nothing.', presses Escape, files an issue with that exact title through the API as a colleague would, reopens the dialog with `c`, types the same title and sees that issue listed with its link. The query now carries staleTime: 0 and gcTime: 0, so every settled title is asked fresh; the 400 ms debounce bounds how often.
proof.negativeControl: Both options removed from the query and the SPA rebuilt: the row red 3 of 3, each at `expect(locator).toBeVisible()` for `getByRole('link', { name: 'CORE-2 Astrolabe drift spoils the mooring calibration' })`, 'element(s) not found' — the cached 'found nothing' answered the second check, which is exactly the defect the reviewer described.

proof.criterion: Finding 4 — the past decision's list item says who answered it, so a screen reader's item for the decision is whole.
proof.surface: the component's unit rows, which render the decision and read its list item by role
proof.observed: 147 pass / 0 fail. `RelatedItemRow` now takes a `children` slot rendered under the link inside the `<li>`, and the `withAsk` flag is gone: the related list passes an ask item's `AskHitStatus`, and the decision passes its 'Answered by …' line and its `AskHitStatus`. The decision row's assertions are scoped with `within(screen.getByRole("listitem"))`, so the link and the answer must be in one item.
proof.negativeControl: The decision's 'Answered by' line and ask state moved back outside the `<li>`: that row fails with 'Unable to find an element with the text: /Answered by alice/' and prints the whole `<li>`, link only — the structure the finding objects to. Restored, 147 pass again.

proof.criterion: Findings 3 and 5, and no regression in the dialog or the palette.
proof.surface: the repository's Chromium suites that drive the create dialog and the palette, plus this change's own spec
proof.command: source /legion/harness/env.sh && cd packages/dispatch && bun e2e/run.ts -- bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium e2e/create-issue-related.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard-issue.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard-palette.e2e.ts
proof.observed: 49 passed (2.2m): this spec's five rows and every row of the three keyboard suites. `RELATED_TITLE_MIN` is now defined once, exported from related-timing.ts and imported by the component (finding 3). packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md's paragraph now names `relatedCheckFormOf` as the one judge, records the fresh check, and says which file proves what: the browser spec for the found form and its control, the fresh check, the debounce, the display gate with aria-busy and the scroll; RelatedItems.test.tsx for the not-made form, the past decision, the failed check with Retry and the two floors (finding 5).
proof.negativeControl: `grep -rn RELATED_TITLE_MIN packages/dispatch` finds the one definition in related-timing.ts and the one import in RelatedItems.tsx, so the duplicate is gone rather than merely unused; and the four specs run above are the only ones in packages/dispatch/e2e that drive the create dialog (`grep -l 'Create issue' e2e/*.e2e.ts`).

filesChanged: packages/envoy-client/src/related-check.ts — reads the contract's union and only words it
packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/RelatedItems.tsx — the same union; staleTime 0 and gcTime 0; one RELATED_TITLE_MIN; the children slot in place of withAsk
packages/dispatch/web/src/features/issue/RelatedItems.test.tsx — the decision row's assertions scoped to its list item
packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md — the one judge, the fresh check, and which file proves what
trickyParts: The CLI's printed output is the hard constraint of finding 1: the classifier reproduces relatedCheckForm's branch order exactly, and every not_made member carries the server's search_query raw and untrimmed, because each caller resolves the words to search by in its own words (the CLI a `dispatch search` line, the dashboard a sentence naming the words).

Dropping `suggestions.related ?? []` is safe because the contract types `related` as a required array and the server constructs one even for a check that was not made (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/suggestions.go:177,376); the callers' own try/catch still stands for a shape neither expects.
